article.headline: Chase Robinson leads Cleveland State over Green Bay 81-66 for 12th straight victory
article.description: — Chase Robinson scored 17 points to lead Cleveland State to an 81-66 victory over Green Bay on Saturday, upping the Vikings' win streak to 12 while handing the Phoenix their 17th loss in a row.
article.linkText: Chase Robinson leads Cleveland State over Green Bay 81-66 for 12th straight victory

categories.description: Green Bay Phoenix @ Cleveland State Vikings

event.description: Green Bay Phoenix @ Cleveland State Vikings

keywords: Green Bay Phoenix @ Cleveland State Vikings
article.story: CLEVELAND -- — Chase Robinson scored 17 points to lead Cleveland State to an 81-66 victory over Green Bay on Saturday, upping the Vikings' win streak to 12 while handing the Phoenix their 17th loss in a row. Robinson shot 5 of 8 from the field and 6 for 9 from the free-throw line for the Vikings (16-6, 10-1 Horizon League). Tevin Smith added 15 points, eight rebounds and five assists. Reece Robinson had 14 points. Yonatan Levy led the Phoenix (2-20, 0-11) with 19 points, nine rebounds, four assists and two steals. Ben Tweedy added 12 points and Preston Ruedinger scored 10. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
